result:
Decision: **CONTINUE**. Round 276 is **SYS-5 stage 1**, with a small RT-FIX check for two retro-document errors C found in round 275. No app code was touched: `store/` has no changes and the frozen-file list still matches.

**Round 275 result**
- C failed it on one row only, RT-IDS, for two Low errors in my retro documents: one retro candidate and one architecture signal had no disposition. Every product and browser check passed (auth guard, playback, export hash, screen counts).
- Gate 275 was skipped, so the baseline for round 276 stays `a4c0e24`.
- I fixed both errors and two of C's wording notes in `retro-275.md`, `screen-review-275.md`, `stops.txt` and `backlog.json` (v240). C re-checks only those lines in round 276 (row RT-FIX-276).
- The task is archived as `tasks/round-275.md`. Nothing became "done" this round. The next regression round is due on 2026-11-02.

**Round 276 task (`current-task.md`)**
- **What changes:** seven transport buttons (Undo, Redo, Split, Delete, Loop, Zoom to selection, Zoom back) stop using native `disabled` and use `aria-disabled` instead. They stay in the Tab order, and pressing or clicking one does nothing. Saba approved this on 2026-10-25 (DUX-R-4(b)).
- **Reasons in tooltips:** Undo, Redo, Split and Delete showed only the action name when unavailable; they now get a reason. The look at rest stays essentially the same, there is no hover highlight, and the focus ring is not dimmed. Keyboard shortcuts are unchanged, because some of them already announce the reason.
- **The two consults agreed on most points:**
  - **product-designer:** a silent no-op, not a status-line message, and focus still jumps to the next sensible button (Delete → Undo, Zoom back → Fit).
  - **tech-lead:** keep the helper inside the transport file for now, move every hover class in the file together, and rekey the focus jump instead of removing it.
- **Disagreement:** tech-lead wanted to dim the whole button; product-designer pointed out that this also dims the focus ring. I chose dimming only the contents. The cost is that the button's faint fill is slightly lighter than before (predicted ΔE 2.43 for the text, 1.99 for the fill); C measures it against that predicted value.
- **Scope:** 10 files may change (the grants file); the other 1,129 are frozen. Tests SD1–SD7 and mutants M1–M5. C checks in the browser at 1440×900 and 1280×720 (Tab order also at 375).
- **Stage 2 (round 277):** the metronome toggle and the library Add button. The backlog had the metronome in the wrong file; it is in `ArrangementTempoRow.tsx`, and that is now corrected.

**Reference:** the WAI-ARIA guide says unavailable toolbar buttons should stay focusable. The Live 12 manual covers Tab navigation but says nothing about unavailable controls, so I recorded "no reference found" rather than guess. I filed `LIVE-MEAS-SYS5-DISABLED` in `user-review/live-checks.md` for root to measure in Live; it does not block the round.

**Caveats:**
- I did not try the change on a scratch copy before writing the task. Instead the task lists the exact test files that will collide, and A must STOP on any other.
- The `aria-disabled:*:opacity-40` class form was never actually compiled, so A must confirm the build emits it first, or STOP.
- I deleted my own working note `b-round-275-checkpoint.md`; it only listed next steps that are now done.
- Two new Lows went to the deferred list (now 466): held Enter on an available Split, Loop or Zoom to selection repeats the action; a sighted keyboard user sees no reason on focus.

Advisor was available and consulted twice: before the plan, and before reporting, when it caught four task errors that I fixed. The main one: the claims table's escaped `|` does not work in `grep -E`, so the claims now run from `b-round-275/claims.sh`.

Sources:
- [WAI-ARIA APG – Developing a Keyboard Interface](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/keyboard-interface/)
- [Ableton Live 12 manual – Accessibility and Keyboard Navigation](https://www.ableton.com/en/live-manual/12/accessibility-and-keyboard-navigation)
- [Ableton – Accessibility in Live Overview](https://help.ableton.com/hc/en-us/articles/11550373507868)
